units.bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the entire serialized JSON body, including keys, escapes and punctuation; KiB = 1024 bytes. Enforce decompressed and wire budgets at ingress.
units.text: Existing utf16 limits preserve JavaScript string.length semantics. Proposed codepoints count Unicode scalar values before trimming; grapheme clusters may contain multiple codepoints. Field and whole-body limits both apply.
units.depth: Root value depth is zero; every property value or array member adds one. Keys and array lengths are limited separately at every container.

pagination.rule: Server-issued opaque cursor bound to current UID/workspace/filter/order and expiry; legacy routes retain their current cursor formats. Apply response byte cap as well as item cap, with stable continuation and explicit unavailable state if one item cannot fit.

stream.rule: Count all frames, heartbeats and UTF-8 framing bytes; apply backpressure. On timeout/disconnect/cancel, abort downstream work and retain partial output only as an uncommitted draft. Complete event is observation only; refetch authorized durable receipt before claiming save. Resume requires current authority and bounded server cursor; expired cursor requires refetch.

files.rule: No file bytes in JSON. Future authenticated upload intent specifies approved MIME, bounded byte size, digest and expiry, then private quarantine upload, verification/scan and owner-authorized finalize. Media/MIME and size policy require separate accepted file/voice scope; do not issue URLs until accepted. Downloads reauthorize current rights and disclose offline residual access.

errors.rule: Proposed errors contain bounded public code/message/request ID and optional retryAfter; never echo body, token, prompt, payment signature or private text. Preserve existing route error shapes until KAN-30 compatibility review. Over-limit rejection precedes side effects and retains browser draft.

retry.rule: Read retry shares original deadline and rechecks authority. Writes do not retry automatically on unknown outcome; read durable receipt/status with same command identity, reauthorize, then replay only identical payload after confirmed no commit. Changed payload or expected revision conflicts preserve draft. Current auth CSRF refresh retry is a specific pre-command rejection path, not permission to replay arbitrary writes. Webhooks keep provider event identity/digest and transaction deduplication.

enforcementHandoff: All profile response/depth/structure/deadline caps are proposals unless specifically listed in observed; route mapping is complete inventory, not proof of runtime enforcement.
KAN-30 owns API DTO/schema paths and must reconcile names and field validation. KAN-31 owns current authority requirements. Neither a size check nor a stream grants permission.

Do not replace global 24 KiB parser to admit project text. Register a method/path-specific reviewed project/submission parser before general parser, with explicit content type, decompression, depth and byte caps.
Preserve webhook raw Buffer before JSON parsing and verify signature on exact bytes before processing; never parse/re-serialize signed bytes or pass webhook through ordinary JSON parser.

No new runtime limits on existing responses until worst-case synthetic legacy profiles, account lists, learning history and billing provider records fit or have compatible pagination. Existing project drafts have no observed numeric body cap; proposed saves must preserve oversize drafts and offer explicit reduction or private file workflow.

Ingress/header/query/time budgets, compression policy, provider deadlines, disconnect cancellation, fleet admission, streaming implementation and hosted/load acceptance remain separate runtime work. Client abort does not prove server cancellation or rollback.
